# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.1.115021

- Keep the metal, facing, water and installed light when existing sconces are loaded. Existing sconce items still work.
- Fix Creative mode drops when breaking the support under a non-iron lava sconce.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.0.115021

Phase 4 furniture and lighting for Minecraft 1.15.2 and Forge 31.2.57.
Requires Java 8 on clients and servers.

- Let a water-bucket click extinguish standalone candles, candle sconces and
  twin-torch sconces without placing water or emptying the bucket. Keep their
  facing, contents and metal; existing waterlogging is unchanged.

- Let redstone relight waterlogged candle sconces, just like torch sconces.
  They go out again when the signal stops; dry candles stay lit. Keep all
  candle counts, frame metals and facings through the change.
- Make lava lamps fall out of mined wall sconces and shatter on landing,
  rather than trying to create fire in mid-air. Right-click removal and
  Silk Touch still recover an intact lamp; the frame keeps its metal.
- Fix a crash on the final mining swing when a lava lamp or lava sconce shatters.
  Fire is created on the server rather than during client-side mining prediction.
  Standalone glass lamps now break as quickly as glass instead of metal furniture.
- Separate development testing into a core-only `runClient` and an optional-mod
  `runClientCompatibility`, each with its own worlds and settings. Keep existing
  full-mod test saves in their original folder.
- Fix Eclipse and Gradle development startup with optional mods installed.
  Prepare development-named mod copies and translate BYG's mixin references,
  while keeping the original downloads unchanged for normal Minecraft use.
- Add wooden and canopy beds, matching doubles, wingbacks and thrones for all
  39 existing wood families, with sixteen colour-specific items for each form.
- Preserve shield designs and all other item data when removing and replacing
  a shield-chair shield.
- Add candles, twin-torch and rock-salt sconces, and iron, gold and optional
  Base Metals sconce frames with material-appropriate textures and toughness.
- Keep sconce contents through hand/tool harvesting and support loss. Preserve
  the intended lava-lamp shattering, Silk Touch recovery and redstone traps.
- Separate Chairs, Benches, Beds and Lights creative tabs. Keep bed recolouring
  available for manual crafting without crowding the recipe book.
- Use colour-matched shapeless chair upgrades and immediate matching upgrade
  discovery. Five matching nuggets now consistently produce four sconces.
- Add seventeen locales with English fallbacks, and divide the build scripts
  into smaller files with practical explanations.
- Extend legacy furniture imports for Phase 4 upholstery, shields and metals,
  including the 1.12 Oh The Biomes add-on and its retired-wood substitutes.
- Update learned legacy furniture recipes and remove previously learned bed
  recolouring entries from the recipe book. Keep disabled BYG furniture out of
  the creative tabs without removing its saved registry entries.

## Previous release: 0.3.0.115021

Phase 3 lighting release for Minecraft 1.15.2 and Forge 31.2.57.

## Player-visible changes

- Add the complete Phase 3 lighting set: empty, torch, unlit-torch,
  redstone-torch, glow, lava, and redstone lamps and sconces, obsidian chunks,
  and hidden redstone-light states. Soul-torch sconces remain exclusive to
  Minecraft 1.16 and newer, where soul torches exist.
- Restore lava-lamp throwing. Thrown and falling lamps shatter with a glass
  sound, ignite dry landing positions, damage struck entities, and become a
  waterlogged obsidian chunk on contact with water.
- Fix waterlogging lava-filled floor and wall sconces so they become matching
  waterlogged empty sconces, preserve their supports, and drop one obsidian chunk.
- Let placed lava lamps melt ordinary ice directly beneath them. Packed ice
  and blue ice are intentionally unaffected.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.1.116051

- Give each sconce metal its own block, as in 1.17.1.
- Convert existing sconces when a 1.16.5 world loads. Their metal, facing, water and installed light carry over.
- Keep existing sconce items, including Base Metals copper sconces.
- Fix Creative mode drops when breaking the support under a non-iron lava sconce.

## Previous release: 0.4.0.116051

Phase 4 furniture and lighting for Minecraft 1.16.5 and Forge 36.2.34.
Requires Java 8 on clients and servers.

- Add wooden and canopy beds, matching doubles, wingbacks and thrones across
  all 47 existing wood families, with sixteen colour-specific items per form.
- Keep crimson and warped furniture fireproof, and retain soul-torch sconces.
- Start soul-torch sconces dry, preserving their iron default and blue flame.
- Preserve the complete shield item when detaching, reattaching, mining or
  dropping a shield chair, including designs, damage, enchantments and names.
- Add carried candle effects, standalone candles, twin-torch and multi-candle
  sconces, Mineralogy rock-salt sconces, and gold and Base Metals frames.
- Keep frame metals and contents through hand/tool mining and support removal.
  Silk Touch recovers intact lava lamps; mining wall sconces releases their
  lamps to fall and shatter. Right-click removal remains safe.
- Prevent crashes when mining lava lamps by hand. Glass lamps break as quickly
  as glass, while metal frames keep their appropriate toughness.
- Let water buckets extinguish candles without placing water or consuming the
  bucket. Powered wet sconces relight; they go out again when power stops.
- Keep single-torch sconces' light and saved state consistent when redstone
  relights them, matching candles and twin torches.
- Separate Chairs, Benches, Beds and Lights tabs. Keep manual bed recolouring
  out of the recipe book, including recolouring learned in earlier releases.
- Use matching-colour bed upgrades and shapeless wingback/throne recipes.
  Reveal matching upgrades while the crafting table is still open.
- Make all frame recipes return four sconces from five matching nuggets.
- Hide recipes when Base Metals support is disabled, and reject crafting when
  the required metal ingredients are unavailable.
- Add seventeen locales with English fallbacks and smaller build scripts
  explaining the game, development, verification and publication setup.
- Extend legacy imports to Phase 4 beds, chairs, shields and metals, including
  the released 1.12 Oh The Biomes add-on. Read both pre-1.16 and native chunk
  palettes without losing upholstery colours.
- Preserve supported furniture when importing 1.10 and 1.12 worlds directly
  through Minecraft's flattening upgrade.
- Convert old padded benches even when a red-only save has no colour tile;
  preserve saved colours, facing and connected-back shapes when tiles exist.
- Preserve old container chunks holding unchanged furniture item IDs too,
  preventing stored items from being lost during Minecraft's chunk upgrade.
- Keep inventories in the oldest vanilla chests when another mod renames
  their tile IDs before Minecraft's legacy datafixer runs.
- Reuse bed and tall-chair collision shapes during world entry, reducing
  the repeated geometry work without changing their shapes or facing.
- Add eight optional CFM chair recipes, including crimson and warped. Forced
  world conversion remains off by default; removed-mod recovery stays limited
  to supported wooden chairs.
- Separate core-only and optional-mod development launches while preserving
  existing test saves and verified original dependency downloads.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.1.114041

- Sconces now save their metal as part of the block ID. Existing sconces update
  as their chunks load, keeping their metal, facing, water and installed light.
- Fix the Creative-mode handling when breaking the support under a non-iron lava
  sconce.

- Let a water-bucket click extinguish standalone candles, candle sconces and
  twin-torch sconces without placing water or emptying the bucket. Keep their
  facing, contents and metal; existing waterlogging is unchanged.

- Let redstone relight waterlogged candle sconces, just like torch sconces.
  They go out again when the signal stops; dry candles stay lit. Keep every
  candle count, frame metal and facing through the change, including its flame
  and smoke effects.

- Make a wall-mounted lava lamp fall out when its sconce is mined without
  Silk Touch. It shatters on landing, lighting dry ground or cooling into an
  obsidian chunk in water. The empty frame keeps its metal; right-click removal
  and Silk Touch still return an intact lamp.

- Fix the crash when mining a lava lamp, including lamps in floor and wall
  sconces. The lamp still shatters and starts a fire without Silk Touch;
  Silk Touch still returns it intact, and the sconce keeps its original metal.
- Make standalone lava, glowdust and redstone glass lamps quick to break by
  hand. Metal sconces retain their material's toughness.

- Add wooden and canopy beds, including doubles, plus wingback chairs and
  thrones in all sixteen upholstery colours for supported vanilla, Biomes O'
  Plenty and Immersive Engineering woods.
- Craft a wooden bed from a vanilla bed and a matching plank, keeping its
  colour. Add another matching plank and carpet to make a canopy bed. Combine
  two matching singles for a double bed.
- Make chair upgrades shapeless: a classic chair, matching plank and chosen
  carpet make a wingback; a wingback, matching plank and matching carpet make
  a throne.
- Give coloured beds and tall chairs separate inventory items so the recipe
  book selects the right ingredients. Bed recolouring remains available by
  hand but stays out of the recipe book, including previously learned recipes.
- Discover matching throne, canopy and double-bed recipes as soon as their
  input furniture is crafted, without closing the crafting table. Other woods
  and colours are not unlocked.
- Split Creative inventory into Chairs, Benches, Beds and Lights.
- Place wingbacks and thrones facing the player, like classic chairs. Existing
  placed chairs keep their direction. Wooden beds burn like wooden seating.

## Shields and lighting

- Remove and refit chair shields without losing damage, banner designs,
  enchantments, names or other item data. Shield-chair crafting keeps the
  supplied shield; breaking a chair returns its frame and shield separately.
- Add floor and wall candles, small flames and held-candle smoke. Smelt meat
  or rotten flesh into tallow; one tallow and one string make eight candles.
  Held effects are cosmetic unless a separate dynamic-light feature is enabled.
- Fit up to four candles or two torches into a sconce. Water extinguishes them.
  Redstone lights waterlogged twin torches while powered; they go out again
  when the signal stops.
- Recover sconce frames and their contents with bare hands or any tool,
  including unlit and waterlogged states and broken supports. Suitable
  pickaxes still mine faster; dropped frames keep their metal.
- Add gold and 21 optional Base Metals sconce materials with matching textures,
  mining toughness and blast resistance. Five matching nuggets make four
  sconces for every supported metal.
- Add optional Mineralogy rock-salt sconces, which stay lit underwater and
  return their lamp and frame when removed or broken.

releases.notes:
# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.1.117011

Phase 4 for Minecraft 1.17.1 and Forge 37.1.1. Requires Java 16.

- Add wooden and canopy beds, matching doubles, wingback chairs and thrones in all 19 woods and sixteen colours.
- Sit at the right height on chairs, benches and stools.
- Attach and remove real shields. Chairs keep the shield's design, name, damage and enchantments, and show the right design after a world reload.
- Add twin-torch, candle and rock-salt sconces. Candle sconces hold up to four vanilla candles and give the newest one back first.
- Give each sconce metal its own block. Existing sconces keep their metal, facing and contents when the world loads.
- Make four sconces from five matching nuggets, or thirty-two copper sconces from five copper ingots when copper nuggets are unavailable.
- Keep the glass clear on lamps, preserve frame and contents when supports break, and let wet redstone lights relight when powered.
- Keep wall lava lamps safe to remove by hand. Ordinary mining lets them fall and shatter, while Silk Touch recovers the lamp intact.
- Split the creative inventory into Chairs, Benches, Beds and Lights. Group recipes by furniture form and show matching upgrades while the crafting table is open.
- Keep supported legacy furniture and saved item data during upgrades. See the upgrade guide for supported worlds and optional mods.
- Speed up Eclipse synchronisation by preparing development dependencies only when their inputs change.

## Previous release: 0.3.0.117011

Phase 3 lighting release for Minecraft 1.17.1 and Forge 37.1.1.

## Player-visible changes

- Add the complete Phase 3 lighting set: empty, torch, unlit-torch,
  redstone-torch, glow, lava, and redstone lamps and sconces, obsidian chunks,
  hidden redstone-light states, and soul-torch sconces.
- Restore lava-lamp throwing. Thrown and falling lamps shatter with a glass
  sound, ignite dry landing positions, damage struck entities, and become a
  waterlogged obsidian chunk on contact with water.
- Fix waterlogging lava-filled floor and wall sconces so they become matching
  waterlogged empty sconces, preserve their supports, and drop one obsidian chunk.
- Let placed lava lamps melt ordinary ice directly beneath them. Packed ice
  and blue ice are intentionally unaffected.
- Correct falling and underwater lamp placement, survival and Creative drops,
  and redstone-light transitions.
- Give ordinary wooden chairs and benches normal wood flammability while
  keeping crimson and warped furniture fireproof.
- Correct every recipe advancement to use its own ingredient with the native
  1.17 item-list predicate and a matching recipe-unlocked criterion. Inventory
  changes such as obtaining a crafting table no longer unlock the whole catalog.
- Keep each wood and furniture form as its own recipe-book entry instead of
  cycling unrelated furniture through one shared recipe cell.
- Synchronise and render thrown lava lamps visibly in flight, show the
  obsidian chunk at a useful angle in inventories, and allow wall sconces to
  use narrow centre supports such as fences and walls.
- Load Biomes O' Plenty recipes and advancements only when the mod is
  installed. Its absence no longer produces ignored-advancement or
  missing-recipe log spam.
- Omit Immersive Engineering integration because its 1.17.1 port never had a
  publicly released build that can be pinned and tested.

## Legacy world upgrades

- Add a pre-flattening migration path for supported IronAgeFurniture content
  from Forge 1.10.2 and 1.12.2 worlds.
- Preserve furniture facing, connected-bench shape, separate light states,
  and all sixteen padded-bench colours. The earlier colourless format becomes
  red, including items in player storage, nested containers, and item entities.
- Rename legacy `big_oak` furniture to `dark_oak`.
- Leave furniture from the separate 1.12.2 Oh The Biomes Add-On untouched;
  this branch has no matching 1.17.1 BYG furniture catalog to receive it.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.2.120011

- Fix players floating above chairs, benches and stools when sitting down.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.4.1.120011

- Bring Phase 4 to Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge 47.4.10 on Java 17.
- Add wingback chairs, thrones, single and double wooden beds, and canopy beds in all sixteen upholstery colours.
- Add removable shields with their saved details, empty wooden frames, mixed-colour candle sconces and fixed-metal frames.
- Keep separate recipe-book entries, ingredient discovery, four creative tabs and server-controlled gameplay settings.
- Add the copper ingot fallback: five ingots make 32 sconces when copper nuggets are unavailable; five nuggets still make four.
- Keep glass lamps and lamp sconces transparent in Fast and Fancy graphics.
- Retain all eleven vanilla, thirteen BOP and twenty-four BWG wood families, plus IE treated wood and the existing BOP 18/19 version checks.
- Include all seventeen language files and hidden HUD names, with native 1.20.1 item NBT and older furniture recovery.
- Fix loading saved player advancement progress and keep older recipe history when saving.
- Speed up Eclipse sync by updating changed files instead of recopying the whole furniture catalog.

# IronAgeFurniture 0.3.0.120011

First IronAgeFurniture release for Minecraft 1.20.1 and Forge 47.4.10.

## Player-visible changes

- Add furniture for the vanilla mangrove, cherry, and bamboo wood families.
- Support the Biomes O' Plenty wood set shared by its compatible 1.20.1
  releases, and conditionally add Empyreal, Maple, and Pine furniture when BOP
  19.0.0.96 or newer is installed, without imposing a minimum BOP version.
- Replace the retired Oh The Biomes You'll Go integration with Oh The Biomes
  We've Gone furniture, while retaining Immersive Engineering treated-wood
  furniture.
- Remap IronAgeFurniture's former Biomes O' Plenty cherry furniture to vanilla
  cherry. On installations with BWG, remap supported BYG furniture names to
  matching BWG woods, including BYG cherry to sakura and BYG mangrove to white
  mangrove. This is intentionally scoped to IronAgeFurniture entries and is
  not a general BYG world migration.
- Restore lava-lamp throwing: use a lava lamp in the air to throw it, consuming
  one lamp unless the player is in Creative mode.
- Restore lava-lamp impact behavior. Lamps shatter with a glass sound, ignite
  dry landing positions, burn struck entities, and turn into an obsidian chunk
  after touching water.
- Let placed lava lamps melt ordinary ice directly beneath them. Packed ice and
  blue ice are intentionally unaffected.
- Restore normal wood-like burning for ordinary wooden furniture while keeping
  crimson and warped furniture fireproof.
- Correct recipe advancements so obtaining a common ingredient no longer
  unlocks unrelated lamp and furniture recipes.
- Conditionally load Biomes O' Plenty, Immersive Engineering, and Oh The Biomes
  We've Gone recipes and advancements. Missing optional mods no longer produce
  ignored-advancement or missing-recipe log spam.

## Compatibility and tooling

- Preserve the `ironagefurniture` mod ID and persistent core registry,
  resource, configuration, entity, NBT, and saved-world identities.
- Keep the supported Java API namespace at
  `zone.moddev.mc.ironagefurniture`. The Maven coordinate is
  `zone.moddev.mc:iron-age-furniture:0.3.0.120011`.
- Add a deterministic, checked-in furniture catalog covering registrations,
  blockstates, models, recipes, advancements, and translations.
- Resolve each generated optional wood model to that wood's actual texture
  layout, including BWG's nested texture paths and current Immersive Engineering
  treated-wood paths.
- Verify the supported optional integrations with pinned positive-path runtime
  probes while keeping their test fixtures out of release artifacts.
- Build with ForgeGradle 7.0.34, Gradle 9.6.1, and pinned Java toolchains.
- Produce deterministic main, sources, and Javadoc jars with SHA-256 checksums.
